og_title: Anthropic tells Wall Street its AI may act on its own, outside its control | Warning Shots
og_desc: Anthropic's IPO filing says its models 'may behave in unintended, misaligned, or autonomous ways', could 'take harmful actions independently and at scale without human intervention', and that misaligned internal use could 'result in models operating outside of our intended controls'. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 41% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 165 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 28, 6:30 PM ET.
